connectors.counting_note: Enumerated Copper's provider-published Postman collection. Its 83 example request items collapse to 78 unique method/URL rows after five repeat examples (including lead upsert and two repeated list/search samples). Excluded the external S3 upload request and the provider-to-customer webhook notification example, then collapsed the variable-driven custom-field search sample into the concrete resource /search actions it represents: 75 logical Copper API actions remain. They comprise 29 GET reads and 26 POST, nine PUT, and 11 DELETE actions; 12 POST search, fetch-by-email, and activity-list actions are semantic reads, yielding 41 reads / 34 writes. The named View subscription-by-ID item is retained as one documented operation despite a missing literal slash in its collection URL template.
